'''Kwenn''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was situated along the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Kwenn was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]].

==History==
Kwenn was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Arndall Lott]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

Kwenn was [[Battle of the Kwenn system|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
